input.objective: Identify the exact San Francisco city agency responsible for this issue and the official reporting channel with its URL. Issue category: graffiti. Prefer official city government pages such as sf.gov and 311.
queries: San Francisco report graffiti 311 Public Works

value.title: Report graffiti issues | SF.gov
value.excerpt: Report graffiti on public or private property. San Francisco Public Works removes graffiti from public property.

value.title: 311 Customer Service Center | SF.gov
value.excerpt: SF 311 is the city's single point of contact for non emergency service requests. Call 311, use the web forms, or use the SF311 mobile app.
